Quarantine malformed input lines into `rejected.ndjson` and continue processing. Never erase existing output to recover a checkpoint.

[m_mvnvkf4fa3ddc97c8d8e03fd65ee] Auxiliary config region and retry overrides are ingestion-only (project; user_statement; confidence 1.00; 2026-10-25)
